prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE new animation key-pose illustration of the exact Chinese grandmother in the three supplied reference images, as a standalone full-body character cutout plate for the short film 《来电》. Reference 1 = approved working turnaround identity and rear clothing design; reference 2 = facial identity; reference 3 = single-character style and proportions. Do not copy their poses or props. This is an elderly grandmother, about 70 years old and 1.50 m tall.

Requested pose: back towards camera with a slight three-quarter turn toward screen right, reaching up onto the top of an unseen tall cabinet. We mostly see the back of her shirt and her low grey bun; a narrow right-facing face profile, glasses and nose are visible, looking upward at her reaching hand, never turning to look at the camera. Her shoulders, torso and pelvis maintain one coherent elderly body with a mild stoop. She rises onto BOTH forefeet to reach: BOTH shoe toes/front soles visibly bear weight at the same implied floor level, both heels lifted a modest few centimeters; natural stable stance, no jump, no dangling legs or floating feet. Show the complete feet and heels with their sole slopes clearly readable. No drawn floor.

Only ONE arm is stretched upward to reach. The anatomical LEFT arm with its ONE green jade bracelet rises beside the head and reaches smoothly overhead, elbow almost extended naturally, intact wrist, open hand with fingertips gently curving forward over the invisible cabinet edge. The arm is comfortably long and fully connected from shoulder through elbow and wrist; no shortened floating arm and no extra limb. The other anatomical RIGHT arm has NO bracelet and stays much lower, bent with its open hand held forward at about upper chest/shoulder height as if lightly steadying against the invisible cabinet. Do not raise both arms overhead. Hands are empty: she has not yet picked up the lamp.

Reach plausibility: the unseen cabinet top is 1.90 m from the floor and the lamp's original position is about 1.98 m. Design a convincing fully reaching 1.50 m grandmother, forefeet supporting the raised heels, fingertips about 0.4 m above her head. This dimensional information is pose guidance only: draw NO cabinet, lamp, ruler, lines or labels.

Keep exact character identity: grey-white hair combed into a low bun; red-bead hairpin; thin round dark-rim glasses; recognizable elderly profile; light blue short-sleeve collared blouse with small WHITE five-petal flowers; dark navy loose trousers; black cloth shoes with white soles. ONE jade bracelet only, on her anatomical LEFT wrist; no jewelry on the right. Preserve natural adult proportions, slight rounded back, and old but capable demeanor.

Style: match the references' clean hand-drawn 2D animation outlines and flat local-color fills. EVEN NEUTRAL FLAT LIGHTING. At most extremely faint local form shading; remove the references' orange under-neck shadow, dramatic clothing shading and directional light. No warm glow, no moonlight, no highlights or cast shadows.

Canvas: portrait PNG, native 1024 by 1536 or larger, long edge MUST be at least 1536 pixels. Grandmother's complete silhouette from topmost reaching fingertips to lowest shoes should occupy 89–93% of the image height with small safe margins, centered, no cropped fingers, wrists, head, trousers, toes or heels. A uniform solid pale neutral gray background edge to edge. Only ONE character. No sheet grid or multiple views. No other people, cabinet, furniture, lantern, sticks, props, room, scenery, floor line, ground shadow, text, annotations, signature, or watermark.
